title: List of Wainwrights
extract: Wainwrights are the 214 English peaks described in Alfred Wainwright's seven-volume Pictorial Guide to the Lakeland Fells (1955–66). They all lie within the boundary of the Lake District National Park in Cumbria, and all but one are over 1,000 feet (304.8 m) in height. Over two million copies of the Pictorial Guides have been sold since their publication. In 1974, Wainwright published a supplementary volume The Outlying Fells of Lakeland (1974), which includes another 116 summits ; these are the Wainwright Outlying Fells.
